itemList.description:
Work of servicing of 400KVA/320 KW Diesel generator set. The job includes

a) Engine servicing- Draining of replacement of engine oil ( 40-50 liters approximately), replacement of engine oil filters, fuel filters, primary & secondary filters, cleaning and replacement of air filters, checking coolant level & radiators, inspect hoses & clamps, fan belts and alternator belt, cleaning battery terminals & checking electrolyte, checking for leaks & abnormal noise & oil leakage.
b) Alternator servicing : Cleaning alternator through blow compressed air through windings. Insulation resistance test using megger, check AVR air through windings. Insulation resistance test using megger, check AVR- verify voltage regulator operation, tighten electrical terminals & inspect bearings.
c) Control Panel: Cleaning panel by removing dust from panels, test protection relays- check alarms & trip functions, check battery charger, test emergency stop switches, verify voltage, current, frequency & hour meters.
d) Fuel & Cooling system: Inspecting fuel tanks, fuel lines, check for leakage, cleaning radiator fins, coolant concentration, inspect water pump.
e) Functional Testing: Run No-Load Test for 15-20 minutes. Load test- run at available load for 30-60 minutes, and record performances- voltage, current, frequency , current, oil, pressure, coolant temperatures & battery charging voltage.
The contractor shall submit all required reports with the list of replaced spares with the signature of service technician.
